Dear Sir / Madam, 
 
Subject: Audio and video recordings of earnings call held on October 15, 2026 
  
This is further to our intimation dated October 7, 2026, informing the exchanges regarding 
the details of the earnings call scheduled on Thursday, October 15, 2026, at 5:30 p.m. (IST) to 
discuss the Company's performance for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. 
  
 
Pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) 
Regulations, 2015, we now wish to inform that the audio and video recordings of the earnings 
call held today i.e. October 15, 2026, are hosted on the website of the Company and are 
available at https://ir.360.one/investor-relations/reports-and-presentations/.  
 
We request you to kindly take the above information on record. 
 
Thanking you. 
Yours faithfully,
